text:
We are a family from Switzerland, and during our stay in Phuket we were looking for a very professional clinic to do the important health check for our baby at the 12-week stage of pregnancy. After some research, we came across this OB-GYN clinic, and we were immediately impressed by the modern and very clean interior as well as the excellent reviews.

From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The doctor is incredibly friendly, warm-hearted, and highly professional. He took the time to answer all our questions with patience and made us feel completely at ease. What we appreciated most was the punctuality and organization — we had an appointment and every time we were seen even earlier than scheduled, which shows their respect for patients’ time.

Coming from Switzerland, we are very familiar with high medical standards, and we can honestly say that this clinic offers the same level of quality and professionalism. We felt truly cared for and safe, and we can recommend this clinic 100% to anyone who is looking for excellent prenatal care in Phuket.

Thank you so much to the doctor and the whole team for such a wonderful experience — it gave us a lot of confidence and peace of mind for our pregnancy journey.
